stories.title: Chapter 7: The "Ren-chan" Transformation
stories.author: Rand
stories.content:
The plan was moving forward, though the tension was rising. While Aoi and Haruto’s stylish disguises drew a few admiring glances, Arisa—occupied with her own group of friends—didn't spare them a second look. To her, they were just more faces in the Saturday mall crowd.

Trailing a safe distance behind, Ren tugged at the hem of her plain, baggy shirt. She had opted for her original female form today but had dressed in the most forgettable, "background character" clothing she owned to ensure no one would connect her to the radiant girl walking ahead.

"Shimizu-san looks so natural with them," Aoi whispered, peering around a pillar. "I almost wish I was over there."

Ren glanced at her, her voice slightly husky as she maintained her practiced tone. "But... aren't you technically at the mall with her right now?"

"It’s not the same, Ren-kun!" Aoi pouted. "Look at the distance we have to keep. We’re 'following' her, not 'hanging out' with her."

"That’s the point of an observation," Ren reminded her. "If we get too close, the natural behavior disappears."

Haruto, meanwhile, was distracted by a nearby display. "Actually, since we’re here, I might want to pick up some new clothes. Two birds with one stone, right?"

"Hmm, maybe I’d like some too," Aoi agreed, looking at her own fashionable outfit. "Maybe something sporty."

Haruto snorted, looking at Aoi’s high-fashion look. "That wouldn't suit you right now. I’d rather see you buy something cute."

"Who are you to tell me what to do?" Aoi snapped, her cheeks pinking. "You're not my mom!"

Ren watched them bicker, a small smile appearing. "Hehe. Looking at you two... you really do look like a couple, don't you?"

Both of them turned beet red. "N-Not a chance!" Aoi barked.

"If she looks like this every day, then maybe," Haruto joked. "Otherwise, no."

"Hehehe, you guys—"

Ren was cut off as Aoi turned a sharp, calculating gaze toward her. "Let me ask you, Ren-kun. If someone looked at us and had to pick the 'odd one out,' what would they say?"

Ren blinked. "W-What a sudden question?"

"She's right," Haruto added, catching Aoi's drift. "Look at you. We're all dressed up for a day out, and you're standing there in... that. It actually makes you stand out more because you look like you're trying to hide."

Ren felt a bead of sweat. "I don't like where this is going..."

"We are already in a clothing shop," Aoi and Haruto said in unison. "So... let's dress you up!"

"No, no, no! Not Haruto too!" Ren protested, but Aoi was already dragging her toward the fitting rooms.

The makeover was more intense than Ren had anticipated. Inside the booth, she had to be extremely careful. Stripping off her "plain" disguise meant revealing her true silhouette—the one that was an exact match for Arisa’s. She worked quickly, sliding into the clothes Aoi tossed over the door, making sure the curtain was sealed tight.

Aoi had picked out a chic, feminine outfit: a soft cream-colored sweater and a stylish jacket that accentuated her frame. When Ren finally stepped out, the "plain" facade was gone. Her hair was brushed out, her face was clear, and she looked stunning.

"Ugh, Aoi... I told you I didn't want to do this," Ren muttered, looking at her feet.

Aoi stood frozen. "O_O Wow... Ren-k... chan... this is way beyond my expectations."

Ren looked up, her face burning. "How do I look? Do I look... 👉👈 weird?"

"Waaaah! I can't hold it anymore! You are such a cutie!!" Aoi lunged forward, hugging her with enough force to knock the wind out of her.

"Owmm hmmm mmmmm!!" Ren muffled. "Hold yourself back!"

"Ah! Sorry!" Aoi released her, flushing. "Let's go show Haruto!"

They walked back to where Haruto was keeping watch. When he turned around, he stopped mid-sentence. He stared at Ren, his jaw nearly dropping.

"Ahhh..." Haruto exhaled, a mock-tear of joy in his eye. "Life surely is great when you're surrounded by cute girls... I wish for nothing more."

Both Aoi and Ren flushed deep red. "N-Now you're just overreacting," Ren stammered.

"No, he's right," Aoi said, adjusting Ren's collar. "You actually look like someone now. Let's go, Shimizu-san is moving toward the fountain!"
